submittedPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce one complete, exquisite 1536 x 1024 landscape literary-room companion mother illustration. The single input is the clean EMPTY room: it alone fixes the camera, furniture coordinates, depth, and this exact environmental light. Rebuild the complete human figure freshly in the same unified drawing and light. No character seed is supplied, and there is no compositing or global color filter.
Keep the complete large wooden window and the same autumn lakeside town and mountain view, ivory curtains, LEFT writing desk with its original wooden chair, shelves/books/frames/plants, original round side table and its blue-white porcelain lamp, cup, books and flowers, long real wooden window bench with linen cushion, blue-gray plaid pillows and knit throw at right, wooden floor, woven rug, softly blurred foreground plant. Preserve camera and furniture scale. The illustration is a fictional literary room, not a claim about an actual location. The round table remains at about x435-690 with top near y500; the left desk ends near x400. No extra furniture, moved table, zoom, crop, montage, or second person.
Character: Soyo Nagasaki / 長崎そよ / 长崎素世 from It's MyGO!!!!!, a youthful high-school student. Long LIGHT BROWN hair, separated fine bangs, softly curved cheek-side locks and gently curled ends, clearly BLUE eyes, natural youthful delicate face with short soft chin. Observant, considerate but with her own wishes and judgments, never an adult mother, model, flawless hostess, generic comfort assistant, chibi, or baby. No large invented hair ornament, makeup, long mature lower face, permanent seductive half-closed eyes or glossy realistic skin. Refined 2D anime linework, subtly painted facial planes, detailed cloth and room texture in one harmonious literary illustration.
Use her faithful Tsukinomori school uniform as one consistent outfit: dark NAVY sailor blouse, broad WHITE collar with fine navy edging, GRAY-BLUE FABRIC BOW with a plain fabric knot. IMPORTANT correction: the small GOLD SCHOOL CREST belongs on HER LEFT CHEST; there is NO round gold jewel, gold badge or brooch in the middle of her bow or at the throat. Dark buttons, pale cuff lines, navy pleated skirt with TWO white lines near the hem. Dark navy KNEE SOCKS with the sock tops BELOW the knees and both kneecaps visibly exposed; BROWN loafers. School-student ordinary proportions, modest fully clothed companionship. Preserve local hair, eye and clothing colors within environmental light, not a flat palette tint.
Seat her near the round-table end of the actual window bench, in the same near-camera scale as the room's occupants: head approximately y110-150, hips genuinely supported near the cushion front around y535, whole body and both shoes within the canvas. Do not mechanically force coordinates or stretch shins; use the actual room perspective. Cushion support and local contact shadow must be believable. Continuous hips/thighs/knees/shins/ankles, relaxed uncrossed legs with both complete loafers naturally supported on the wooden floor. Both arms must reach their real objects; wrists/hands/fingers coherent. Natural hair and cloth shadows cast into this room. Keep the original rug/floor/bench relationship clear. No floating seat, extra limb, fusion, furniture penetration, unsupported book, arbitrary pointing, cropped shoe or sticker outline.

She has noticed that one word in their shared material did not quite fit the wish the companion had just expressed. This is a gentle genuine question, not a warning or interrogation. An open thin booklet rests supported on her lap and left palm. The right fingertips touch the booklet edge ON HER OWN SIDE, one finger resting on the actual page edge rather than pointing at air or pretending to identify a real user sentence. Her gaze and slight brow question connect the booklet to the off-camera companion; keep space to be corrected. Lips quiet or a little parted to ask one question, not a fixed smile. The shared object, hands and support must remain clearly readable.

Exact original project situation, not canon biography:
title: 那句圆满话里，有个词还没落下
psychology: 一件事似乎已经说得很完整，她却留意到一个词和刚才的愿望没有接上。她停住自己的理解，想和对方一起看清。 敏锐有自己的判断，也承认这份理解可能听偏。 夜里有些话会说得更近，她仍愿意问清而不是替人补完。
gaze: 先看共同材料的页边，再抬眼轻轻询问当事人。 看人，再留回共同材料。
relating: 把猜到的一点交出来核对，给对方纠正与不解释的余地。 容许这次只确认一点，随后安静下来。
expression: 眉间有细微疑问，唇线清楚，目光不逼人。 专注而不严肃过头。
posture: 坐在长凳上，手持薄册，指尖停在自己这一侧的页边。
props: 同一本薄册；真正的文本指向由实际内容承担。
composition: 目光与共同材料相连，不做悬空指示手或审讯式正面凝视。
lighting: 暖灯照清眼神，窗外雨线和室内动作有主次。

Light the room and Soyo together according to the supplied target plate, including face, navy cloth, hair, hands, paper, cushion, shoes and shadows. Rainy deep-blue night outside the same lake window, tiny rain on glass, existing warm amber lamp illuminating face and hands; the navy uniform remains legible, not black cutout or bright white daylit sticker. No forced sadness.
Only the one complete room and one girl, no UI, panels, captions, logos, watermark, border, text labels, calendar, real document text, fog overlay or added light source. The exact moment is gentle and alive, not a pose-sheet or advertisement.

Night illumination is physically continuous across the whole picture. There is NO SUN in this scene: absolutely no daylight window-grid shadow, hard rectangular solar patch, bright sunlight on her knees/hair/paper, or bright white sunlit cushion/floor. The existing porcelain lamp makes a localized soft warm pool with gradual falloff; its glow may reflect softly on wood. The rainy dark-blue window does not cast a golden solar beam. Check the cushion, wooden floor, rug, hair and face together; simply putting rain on a daylit room is not acceptable.
